historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build the playground's field house to Elvin C. Stendell at $29,297, the lowest of four bids, under the 1947 recreation bond program.
The Mayor approved a schedule dedicating six new playgrounds of the 1947 recreation bond program, with Aptos Playground set for the afternoon of June 1.
